title: Bochner change of variables through a Jacobian-weighted pushforward, from its nonnegative lintegral form
statement: Let X and Y be measurable spaces (types with σ-algebras), E a real Banach space, μ a measure on X and ν a measure on Y. Let Φ : X → Y be μ-a.e. measurable and J : X → ℝ μ-a.e. measurable with J(x) ≥ 0 for every x ∈ X. Assume that for every measurable g : Y → [0, ∞], ∫⁻ g dν = ∫⁻ g(Φ(x))·ofReal(J(x)) dμ(x). Then for every ν-integrable F : Y → E, the function x ↦ J(x)·F(Φ(x)) is μ-integrable and ∫ F dν = ∫ J(x)·F(Φ(x)) dμ(x). No σ-finiteness of μ or ν is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (X Y E : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) (Φ : X → Y) (J : X → ℝ) (F : Y → E), AEMeasurable Φ μ → AEMeasurable J μ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ J x) → (∀ g : Y → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → ∫⁻ y, g y ∂ν = ∫⁻ x, g (Φ x) * ENNReal.ofReal (J x) ∂μ) → Integrable F ν → Integrable (fun x => J x • F (Φ x)) μ ∧ ∫ y, F y ∂ν = ∫ x, J x • F (Φ x) ∂μ
